headline: Ventures hosts third annual Co-Op Day to increase regional cooperative economies.
summary: Ventures is gearing up for its third annual Co-Op Day, taking place on Friday, Oct. 9, at One Main Street in Salinas.
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
